title: 한눈에 ④: 들은 말 전하기 — 뭐라고 했어요?
objective: Report a statement, a question, a command or a suggestion with the right -고 하다 form, and change it into the short spoken form.
summary: How to report what someone said, asked, told you to do, or suggested, using -다고, -냐고, -라고 and -자고 and their short spoken forms.

task.title: Report what people said
task.line: Change each quote into indirect speech, choose the right form, or write the short spoken form.

forms.when: Reporting a statement with an action verb. Vowel stem + -ㄴ다고, consonant stem + -는다고. ㄹ-stem verbs drop ㄹ and take -ㄴ다고 (살다 → 산다고, 만들다 → 만든다고). Past: -았/었다고. Future: -(으)ㄹ 거라고.
forms.exampleMeaning: Sujin said she is moving tomorrow.

forms.when: Reporting a statement with an adjective, or with 있다/없다. Add -다고 straight to the stem.
forms.example: 가게 사장님이 오늘은 좀 바쁘다고 하셨어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: The shop owner said he is a bit busy today.

forms.when: Reporting a statement that ends in a noun + 이다. After a vowel use -라고; after a consonant use -이라고.
forms.exampleMeaning: Minho said he is an office worker.

forms.when: Add -냐고 to verbs, adjectives and N + 이다 (past: -았/었냐고). ㄹ-stem verbs drop ㄹ (살다 → 사냐고, 만들다 → 만드냐고).
forms.exampleMeaning: The staff member asked if I was taking it to go.

forms.when: Reporting a command or request. Vowel stem + -라고, consonant stem + -으라고. ㄹ-stem verbs take -라고 directly (만들다 → 만들라고). Negative: -지 말라고.
forms.exampleMeaning: The teacher told us to hand in the homework by tomorrow.

forms.when: Reporting a suggestion ("Let's ~"). Add -자고 to the verb stem. Negative: -지 말자고.
forms.example: 친구가 주말에 같이 영화 보자고 했어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: My friend suggested we watch a movie together this weekend.

forms.when: Used in casual speech. -다고 해요 → -대요, -(으)라고 해요 and N -(이)라고 해요 → -래요, -자고 해요 → -재요, -냐고 해요 → -냬요.
forms.means: (I heard) they say / tell / suggest / ask ~
forms.exampleMeaning: The news says it will snow tomorrow.

watchOut: 먹다고 (X) → 먹는다고 (O): In the present tense, action verbs take -ㄴ/는다고, not just -다고.
물 좀 주라고 했어요 (X) → 물 좀 달라고 했어요 (O): If the speaker wants something for themselves, use 달라고. Use 주라고 when it is for someone else.
같이 가래요 (X) → 같이 가재요 (O): "Let's ~" becomes -재요. -래요 is for commands.
exercises: Fill in the blank with -다고 or -(이)라고: ① 지수: "이 식당 음식이 맛있어요." → 지수 씨가 이 식당 음식이 ____ 했어요. ② 동생: "내일은 내 생일이야." → 동생이 내일은 자기 생일____ 했어요.
Fill in the blank with -냐고: ① 엄마: "저녁 먹었니?" → 엄마가 저녁을 ____ 물어보셨어요. ② 친구: "그 가방 비싸?" → 친구가 그 가방이 ____ 물었어요.
Choose the right word: ① 의사가 당분간 술을 마시지 (말라고 / 말자고) 했어요. ② 친구가 비가 오니까 같이 택시를 (타라고 / 타자고) 했어요.
Write the short spoken form: ① 날씨가 춥다고 해요. → ____ ② 빨리 오라고 해요. → ____ ③ 점심 같이 먹자고 해요. → ____ ④ 언제 오냐고 해요. → ____
Answer in Korean with a short spoken form: You hear this at the subway station: "3번 출구는 공사 중입니다." Tell your friend what it said.
answers: ① 날씨가 춥대요. ② 빨리 오래요. ③ 점심 같이 먹재요. ④ 언제 오냬요.
